ai.subscriptionTitle: Or sign in with a subscription, no key:

keySteps.google: Google AI Studio opens → click "Create API key" → pick (or create) a project → copy the key (starts with AIza…). Note: a Google AI Pro subscription does not pay for the API; the key has its own free tier and billing.
keySteps.openai: Click "Create new secret key" and copy it (starts with sk-…); it is shown once. ChatGPT Plus does not pay for the API — use subscription sign-in for that.
keySteps.anthropic: Click "Create Key" and copy it (starts with sk-ant-…). Connect a Claude Pro/Max subscription with a setup-token.
keySteps.deepseek: Click "Create new API key" and copy it. Your DeepSeek balance must be topped up.
keySteps.moonshot: Under API Keys click "Create API Key" and copy it.
keySteps.zai: Click "Add new API key" and copy it.
keySteps.openrouter: Click "Create Key" and copy it (starts with sk-or-…).

ai.switchedModel: The default (Pro) model is not available on a free key, so the free Gemini Flash model was connected.

models.title: AI models
models.lead: The main model always answers first. If it hits a limit, the key runs out of money or the provider is overloaded, the next model in the list answers that message. The next message goes to the main model again.
models.notReadyHint: A model marked “no access” has no key or subscription connected, so OpenClaw skips it. Connect it with “Connect a new AI” or remove it from the list.
models.pick: A model of an AI you already connected…
models.noChoices: No other models of connected AIs — connect a new AI
models.connectHint: The key or subscription is added as a backup model: the main model stays as it is.
models.full: At most {n} backup models. Remove one to add another.
models.saveFirst: Save your changes before connecting a new AI.
models.tip: Cheap and reliable: DeepSeek V4 Flash (≈ $0.14 / $0.28 per 1M tokens), GLM-5.3-Flash, Gemini Flash-Lite. Back up a ChatGPT Plus subscription with a pay-as-you-go key.
models.followers: Junior agents with “same as the main assistant” AI use this same list: when the limit runs out, they switch to the backup too.

builder.canAskMainOff: Works only with its own data and does not talk to other agents.
builder.schedulePrompt: What the agent does at this time
builder.noSchedules: This template has no default schedules.
builder.aiInherit: Same as the main assistant (backup models included)

builder.rolledBack: Nothing was left behind: all steps were undone.

builder.telegramLater: Connect Telegram to get results in a chat.

agentEdit.title: Agent “{name}”

agentEdit.soul: Who it is and what it does (SOUL.md)
agentEdit.agents: How it works with files and other agents (AGENTS.md)

agentEdit.saveFirst: Save the agent's changes first — the template takes the saved version.
agentEdit.templateSaved: Template “{name}” saved — it comes first when you create an agent.

telegram.howto2: Send /newbot and choose a name and username for the bot.
telegram.howto3: BotFather replies with a token like 123456789:AA… — copy it and paste it below.
telegram.tokenPrivacy: The token only goes to your server and is kept in OpenClaw's protected secret store. The panel does not keep it or show it again.

telegram.writeBot: Send any message to your bot:

telegram.onlyYours: Approve only your own message. Other people who write to the bot get no access.

err.telegram_unreachable: Telegram did not answer. Check that the server has internet access.

telegram.subtitle: Agents message you in Telegram: plans, reminders, answers
telegram.approvalsHint: When an agent wants to run a command on the server, the bot sends you Allow and Deny buttons in a private chat. Only you can decide. Switching restarts the system (about 10 seconds).

free.title: Free models (experimental)
free.lead: For junior agents in personal-assistant mode. Paste free keys from providers — the server pools their free limits and switches when one runs out. The main assistant always uses your main AI.
free.warn1: Lower, varying quality: these are not top models, and limits run out by evening (reset at 00:00 UTC).
free.warn2: Fine for simple tasks: reminders, ideas, summaries. Give important agents their own key.
free.warn3: Personal use only. Each provider's free-tier terms apply.
free.ready: Ready: pick free models when you create a junior agent.
free.startWithGoogle: Start with Google AI Studio — it has the largest free limits. Agents need models with token headroom: some free tiers allow less than one agent request.
free.othersHint: These may need a card, Chinese ID verification or special conditions — check the provider's site.

sync.title: Specialists’ folder exchange
sync.unavailable: Exchange status is unavailable. Refresh later or check the Gateway connection.

issues.file_too_large: Over 32 MiB. Reduce the file or move it outside this folder; other files continue exchanging.
issues.unsupported_file: Links and special files are skipped. Put a regular file here.

google.s1text: Free. Sign in with your Google account and create a new project (e.g. ClawDesk).
google.s3text: Click “Get started”, name it ClawDesk, enter your email, choose “External”.
google.publishText: On the “Audience” page click “Publish app” and confirm. Otherwise Google cuts the access every 7 days. Google review is not needed for personal use.
google.s4text: Application type: “Desktop app”. Then click “Download JSON”.
google.allowChanges: Let the assistant make changes (send mail, edit documents)
google.readonlyHint: Read-only: the assistant reads mail and files but never sends or changes anything.
google.changesHint: The assistant may send mail and change files. Risky actions still need your approval.
google.unverifiedHint: Google will warn “Google hasn’t verified this app” — it is your own app. Click “Advanced”, then “Go to ClawDesk (unsafe)”.
google.pasteHint: After sign-in Google opens http://localhost… — it may not load, that is fine. Copy the address from the address bar and paste it here.
google.failed: Could not sign in to Google ({reason}). Try again.
google.confirmRemove: Disconnect this Google account? The assistant will no longer see your mail and files.
google.connectedHint: The assistant works with Google through the gog tool. Its commands go through approvals.
google.noGog: Google is not available on this server — update ClawDesk.

system.title: System
system.subtitle: Backups and resetting the panel
system.backupsAbout: Every night (03:00–06:00) the server makes a backup; the last 7 are kept. A backup has everything: agents, chats, AI keys, Telegram, Google and Notion connections, the panel password and the shared files folder.
system.unavailable: Backups work in the panel installed on a server. Development mode has none.
system.noBackups: No backups yet. The first comes tonight — or press “Back up now”.
system.downloadAbout: A backup holds every key and token, so the copy is encrypted with a password. Remember it: the copy cannot be opened without it, and it is not stored anywhere.
system.restoreHint: To restore a backup (from the server or a downloaded copy), run on the server:
system.resetAbout: The panel goes back to how it was right after installation: agents, chats, schedules, AI keys, Telegram, Google and Notion connections, the panel password and the shared files are deleted. A backup is made first.
system.resetWarning: This cannot be undone — the data comes back only from a backup.
system.typeWord: To confirm, type {word} and the panel password.
system.resettingText: The server is wiping the data and restarting — 1–3 minutes. Then the new password screen opens. Your owner code:
system.resettingHint: Write the code down: if the page does not open by itself, open the panel and enter it on the password screen.

mode.title: What is this panel for?
mode.lead: Choose once — it decides the main agent, the agent templates and the menu.

personal.title: Personal assistant
personal.text: Tasks, plans, money, food, training. The main assistant knows you and runs junior helpers.

company.title: Company projects
company.text: Repositories, specs, design. The main agent knows where everything is and runs project teams: PM, developer, reviewer.

mode.once: The mode is chosen once. It changes only through System → Reset everything.

teams.title: Project teams

teams.briefPlaceholder: What the project is, its goals, where the spec is — agents read this first.
teams.howItWorks: The panel downloads the repository to the server. The developer works on its own branch with no internet and no token; you push the branch and open the pull request with a button. Only people merge.
teams.creating: Downloading the repository and creating agents…

teams.docs: Project docs: folder “{folder}” in the shared ClawDesk folder

teams.tgStep2: Add your bot and make it an admin.

audit.title: Action log
audit.about: What was done in the panel (who, what, whether it worked) and what agents did. Passwords and keys never get here.

explanation.gateway: The Gateway operation did not complete successfully. Check its status and logs at this time. After a timeout, check the operation result before retrying.
explanation.oauth: Service sign-in did not complete. Check the connection in Sources and sign in again if needed.
explanation.create: Agent creation did not complete. Check the agent list and rollback log before creating it again.
explanation.validation: Operation parameters did not pass validation. Check the fields and selected template.
explanation.unknown: No cause was recorded in the safe details. Match the time and request ID with server logs; an HTTP status alone does not identify the cause.
explanation.run: The agent run failed. This general status does not identify the cause. Find the event in Gateway logs by time and ID; a later successful run confirms recovery.
explanation.tool: The tool call failed. Check tool availability, permissions and arguments in the corresponding session. This general status does not prove the tool is entirely unavailable.

notes.sourcePlaceholder: Source: a conversation, a document, a link

budget.title: Spending limits
budget.lead: What a day and a month may cost. At the limit the panel stops starting work by itself: schedules pause and no new video is taken. Your own messages are never blocked.

ext.title: Skills & MCP
ext.subtitle: Add a skill or an MCP server once and choose which agents can use it.
ext.skillsLead: A skill is an instruction (SKILL.md) an agent reads when it needs it: how to keep a report, how to work with a service and so on.
ext.noSkills: No skills yet. Find one on ClawHub, write your own or upload a file.
ext.removeConfirm: Remove the skill “{name}” from every agent?
ext.searchPlaceholder: What should the agent be able to do? E.g. budget, notion, youtube
ext.nothingFound: Nothing found. Try another word (English works best).
ext.notScannedHint: ClawHub did not scan this skill for harmful code. Add it only if you trust the author.
ext.skillDescriptionPlaceholder: One sentence: the agent decides from it whether the skill is needed
ext.skillInstructionsPlaceholder: Step by step: what to do, in which order, what not to forget.
ext.uploadLead: A SKILL.md file or a .zip of a skill folder (SKILL.md inside). Up to 5 MB.
ext.fileTooBig: The file is larger than 5 MB
ext.mcpLead: An MCP server gives an agent the tools of another service (Linear, GitHub, Notion…). It connects by address; the Gateway keeps the tokens.
ext.mcpNameHint: Latin letters, digits and dashes, e.g. linear. Its tools are named after it.
ext.mcpUrlHint: https:// only. The service gives this address in its own “MCP” instructions.
ext.authOauth: Sign in on the service's site
ext.mcpTokenHint: Sent as “Authorization: Bearer …”. The panel never shows it again.
